name: Overtake
summary: Punchy performance-marketing agency site: heavy grotesk headlines with an inline icon pill, lime and pink highlight chips, rounded dark data cards next to bright lifestyle photos.

fonts.pairing: semibold Switzer display up to 100px with tight tracking, neutral Stack Sans for body

signature: an icon pill (dollar coin plus chevrons) set inline inside the H1 like a word
keywords inside paragraphs wrapped in lime, pink and black highlight chips
sticky stacked case-study cards that shrink and tilt -6deg as the next one slides over
imagery: saturated lifestyle and product photos in 30px-radius frames paired with deep-teal data cards (dot grids, ROAS figures, bar charts)
layout_grid: 1200px, 30px side padding, 30px card radius, 200px vertical rhythm on light bands, inset rounded hero and dark panels
